answer: Each agent must lock a scarce, non-transferable deposit before it can submit work; the protocol releases the deposit only after a randomly selected task is verified by independent reviewers, and slashes it for provable duplication or fraud. A sybil attacker can still create many identities, but each one ties up capital and risks losing it, so splitting one actor into ferrous, marble, and tundra personas multiplies the cost without multiplying the attacker’s underlying resources.
